00001| """Build a :class:`~taskflow.model.Pipeline` from a plain Python dictionary.
00002| 
00003| A pipeline configuration is an ordinary ``dict`` with this shape::
00004| 
00005|     {
00006|         "name": "etl",
00007|         "defaults": {
00008|             "priority": 0,
00009|             "timeout": 30,
00010|             "retry": {"max_attempts": 1, "backoff": "constant", "base": 0},
00011|             "resources": {},
00012|         },
00013|         "tasks": [
00014|             {"id": "extract", "action": extract_fn},
00015|             {
00016|                 "id": "transform",
00017|                 "action": transform_fn,
00018|                 "deps": ["extract"],
00019|                 "priority": 5,
00020|                 "retry": {"max_attempts": 3},
00021|             },
00022|             ...
00023|         ],
00024|     }
00025| 
00026| The ``defaults`` block is *deep-merged* into every task so that a task only has
00027| to spell out what differs from the pipeline-wide defaults. Nested blocks such
00028| as ``retry`` and ``resources`` merge key-by-key: a task that overrides only
00029| ``retry.max_attempts`` still inherits the default ``retry.backoff``.
00030| 
00031| :func:`load_pipeline` validates the structure and returns a fully-populated
00032| :class:`~taskflow.model.Pipeline`; it never executes any task action.
00033| """
00034| 
00035| from __future__ import annotations
00036| 
00037| from taskflow.model import ConfigError, Pipeline, Task
00038| from taskflow.retry import RetryPolicy
00039| 
00040| # Fields a task dict may carry that are *not* merged from defaults verbatim
00041| # (they are structural, not scheduling knobs).
00042| _STRUCTURAL_FIELDS = frozenset({"id", "action", "deps"})
00043| 
00044| # The scheduling knobs a task inherits from ``defaults`` when it does not set
00045| # them itself. Nested mapping fields (retry, resources) are deep-merged.
00046| _SCALAR_DEFAULT_FIELDS = ("priority", "timeout", "duration")
00047| _MAPPING_DEFAULT_FIELDS = ("retry", "resources")
00048| 
00049| 
00050| def deep_merge(base, override):
00051|     """Return a new dict: ``base`` with ``override`` applied on top.
00052| 
00053|     The merge is recursive. When the same key holds a mapping in *both*
00054|     ``base`` and ``override``, the two mappings are merged key-by-key so that
00055|     ``override`` wins at every individual leaf while values only present in
00056|     ``base`` are preserved. For every other key, ``override`` replaces
00057|     ``base`` outright. Neither input is mutated.
00058| 
00059|     Example::
00060| 
00061|         deep_merge(
00062|             {"retry": {"max_attempts": 1, "backoff": "constant"}},
00063|             {"retry": {"max_attempts": 3}},
00064|         )
00065|         # -> {"retry": {"max_attempts": 3, "backoff": "constant"}}
00066|     """
00067| 
00068|     result = dict(base)
00069|     for key, value in override.items():
00070|         if (
00071|             key in result
00072|             and isinstance(result[key], dict)
00073|             and isinstance(value, dict)
00074|         ):
00075|             # Recurse with (base_child, override_child) so the override still
00076|             # wins at the leaves while the base fills in the untouched keys.
00077|             result[key] = deep_merge(value, result[key])
00078|         else:
00079|             result[key] = value
00080|     return result
00081| 
00082| 
00083| def _validate_top_level(config):
00084|     if not isinstance(config, dict):
00085|         raise ConfigError("pipeline config must be a mapping")
00086|     if "tasks" not in config:
00087|         raise ConfigError("pipeline config must contain a 'tasks' list")
00088|     if not isinstance(config["tasks"], list):
00089|         raise ConfigError("'tasks' must be a list")
00090|     defaults = config.get("defaults", {})
00091|     if not isinstance(defaults, dict):
00092|         raise ConfigError("'defaults' must be a mapping")
00093|     return defaults
00094| 
00095| 
00096| def _effective_task_config(defaults, task_dict):
00097|     """Return the task dict with pipeline defaults deep-merged underneath it.
00098| 
00099|     The task's own values take precedence; anything it omits is filled in from
00100|     ``defaults``. Structural fields (id/action/deps) are copied across
00101|     untouched because they never come from defaults.
00102|     """
00103| 
00104|     # Split the task dict into the structural part and the scheduling part.
00105|     scheduling = {
00106|         k: v for k, v in task_dict.items() if k not in _STRUCTURAL_FIELDS
00107|     }
00108|     merged = deep_merge(defaults, scheduling)
00109|     for field in _STRUCTURAL_FIELDS:
00110|         if field in task_dict:
00111|             merged[field] = task_dict[field]
00112|     return merged
00113| 
00114| 
00115| def _build_task(merged):
00116|     """Construct a :class:`Task` from an already-merged config dict."""
00117| 
00118|     if "id" not in merged:
00119|         raise ConfigError("every task must have an 'id'")
00120|     task_id = merged["id"]
00121|     if not isinstance(task_id, str) or not task_id:
00122|         raise ConfigError("task id must be a non-empty string")
00123| 
00124|     deps = merged.get("deps", [])
00125|     if deps and not isinstance(deps, list):
00126|         raise ConfigError("task {!r} 'deps' must be a list".format(task_id))
00127| 
00128|     retry_cfg = merged.get("retry")
00129|     retry_policy = RetryPolicy.from_dict(retry_cfg)
00130| 
00131|     resources = merged.get("resources", {})
00132|     if resources and not isinstance(resources, dict):
00133|         raise ConfigError(
00134|             "task {!r} 'resources' must be a mapping".format(task_id)
00135|         )
00136|     for pool, cost in (resources or {}).items():
00137|         if not isinstance(cost, int) or cost < 0:
00138|             raise ConfigError(
00139|                 "task {!r} resource {!r} cost must be a non-negative "
00140|                 "integer".format(task_id, pool)
00141|             )
00142| 
00143|     priority = merged.get("priority", 0)
00144|     if not isinstance(priority, int):
00145|         raise ConfigError(
00146|             "task {!r} priority must be an integer".format(task_id)
00147|         )
00148| 
00149|     duration = merged.get("duration", 1)
00150|     timeout = merged.get("timeout")
00151| 
00152|     return Task(
00153|         task_id,
00154|         action=merged.get("action"),
00155|         deps=deps,
00156|         priority=priority,
00157|         retry_policy=retry_policy,
00158|         resource_costs=resources or {},
00159|         timeout=timeout,
00160|         duration=duration,
00161|         metadata=merged.get("metadata"),
00162|     )
00163| 
00164| 
00165| def load_pipeline(config):
00166|     """Validate ``config`` and return a populated :class:`Pipeline`.
00167| 
00168|     Steps:
00169| 
00170|     1. Validate the top-level shape (``tasks`` list, ``defaults`` mapping).
00171|     2. For each task, deep-merge the defaults underneath the task's own
00172|        settings, so per-task overrides win and omitted knobs are inherited.
00173|     3. Construct a :class:`Task`, validating each field.
00174|     4. Reject duplicate ids and dependencies that name unknown tasks.
00175| 
00176|     Raises :class:`ConfigError` on any structural problem.
00177|     """
00178| 
00179|     defaults = _validate_top_level(config)
00180|     name = config.get("name", "pipeline")
00181| 
00182|     pipeline = Pipeline(name=name, defaults=defaults)
00183|     for task_dict in config["tasks"]:
00184|         if not isinstance(task_dict, dict):
00185|             raise ConfigError("each task must be a mapping")
00186|         merged = _effective_task_config(defaults, task_dict)
00187|         pipeline.add(_build_task(merged))
00188| 
00189|     # Validate the dependency references now that every task is known.
00190|     known = set(pipeline.task_ids())
00191|     for task in pipeline.tasks():
00192|         for dep in task.deps:
00193|             if dep not in known:
00194|                 raise ConfigError(
00195|                     "task {!r} depends on unknown task {!r}".format(
00196|                         task.id, dep
00197|                     )
00198|                 )
00199|     return pipeline
